title: Native Styles and protected alternative edits for assistants
notes: AI-assisted implementation: discover and apply the live preset catalog with shared GUI Amount baselines and persistent indicators; snapshot unsaved edits in virtual copies, set ratings/labels/flags, assess existing edit depth, open read-only side-by-side Reference View request user-confirmed deletion and adopt the AI copy recipe onto the original as one labelled undoable step before copy-only deletion. Exact JSON floating-point roundtrips prevent unchanged extrapolated Style curves from being rejected as stale. Assessment counts transform and manual lens edits while exempting crop/aspect and derived caches. No compare wipe, preset creation/import, personal profile setup or automatic publication. Finalize never deletes the original RAW: keep both, discard only the AI copy, or adopt its recipe and confirm copy-only deletion.
